claim: Few campaign maps light open ground with lamp sprites: 91 visible light-tile sprites stand under the sky in 15 of 43 maps, 34 of them at E1M4's fair (candles 560, flames 2101, posts 640, bonfires 3566) and 29 street lamps 2493 in the snow maps (E2M3 14, E2M5 11, E2M2 2, E2M4 2). E3M1, the town, has none but one bonfire (sprite 329): its streets are lit by sector shade alone.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/consolidation_probe_outdoor_lamps.py over bloodmap.corpus.campaign_maps(), 2026-11-26: visible sprites (no cstat 32768, statnum not 10) of the probe's own set of light tiles (its LIGHT, line 11: 21 tiles, among them 640/693/676/677/560/938) in sectors whose ceiling is parallax

use: A town street may go unlamped as E3M1's does and be lit by shade; where lamps stand outdoors, use what Blood does: street lamps 2493 by snowy paths, posts 640 at a fair or graveyard, candles and flames at stalls.
